submitted.rationale: EQE falls steadily as Sb increases: 0.637% at idx0 (Fe 0.87), 0.577% at idx1 and 0.099% at idx8. XRD at idx 0, 4 and 8 shows the same rutile-type (FeSbO4-like) phase. Only idx0 has an extra weak low-Q peak, which suggests a little of an Fe-rich phase. The Sb-rich end (idx22) is still rutile plus minor Sb-oxide peaks, so there is no sign of a better absorber there. Idx0, the most Fe-rich composition, is the best measured.

rejected.reason: Measured 0.577%, lower than idx0, which fits the downward trend with Sb
Measured 0.099%; same rutile phase, more Sb, much lower EQE
XRD at idx22 shows the same rutile phase plus Sb oxides, and no new visible-light absorber; EQE trend points away from it
